reasoning: 驗證目標：已在清單頂端時請求 Scroll Up，回捲至清單底端。為什麼這樣切：條款是邊界行為，故前置條件明確置於頂端這個邊界上，並在越界前後各讀一次——邊界前一次仍為一般捲動，邊界上一次為回捲；只在頂端停住不動的實作應失敗。ER 指名「清單底端」而非任意位置（§8.4.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Scroll Up at the top of the list wraps to the bottom
tcs.test_item: If a Scroll Up is requested and the HU is currently at the top of the list, the HU shall wrap-around to the bottom of the list
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. A list is displayed whose first and last entries are known and which is longer than one screen
5. The list is positioned one row below the top of the list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Request Scroll Up once and read the list position
2. Request Scroll Up once more and read the list position
tcs.expected_result:
1. The list is at the top of the list and the first entry is shown
2. The list is at the bottom of the list and the last entry is shown
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
